newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-VILNIUS, UKIO DROP IN EARLY MARKET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-VILNIUS, UKIO DROP IN EARLY MARKET TRADE.

text.p: Vilnius Bank and Ukio Bank saw their shares drop while other blue chips continued a slight rise in early trade on Wednesday, dealers said.
The biggest private financial institution in the country, Vilnius Bank, saw its shares dip to 234 litas from 259.9 litas.
The bank reported earlier its 1996 net profit of 24.4 million litas but also said it intends to keep the major part of it within the institution to develop its computer network.
Ukio Bank shares continued to go down and were traded at 17.1 litas versus 19 litas.
Hermis Bank remained stable at 190 litas while Lithuanian Savings Bank gained to 270 litas from 247 litas.
